entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: H-Hey, um... I've been thinking[n]a little bit about Akiyama-kun...

entries.en: Oh... I get it.

entries.speaker: Mishima

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Look where that got me though...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm just a selfish loser clinging[n]desperately to your popularity...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I don't deserve to work alongside[n]the valiant Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...Well, thanks for everything! Bye!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Owwwwww...

entries.speaker: Mishima

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm such an idiot... Hahaha...[n]I can't even run away right...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: *sigh*

entries.speaker: Mishima

entries.speaker: Mishima

entries.speaker: Mishima

I'm sure there is.
I hope so.
Maybe the Phan-Site?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: [lName]...!

entries.speaker: Mishima

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: How could I have forgotten[n]something as important as that!?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Me too...

entries.speaker: Mishima

entries.speaker: Mishima

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: After all that happened to me with[n]Kamoshida, I know how hard it can be[n]to speak out against injustice...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: So... as long as there are voices[n]crying out to the Phantom Thieves,[n]I'm gonna help them be heard.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: At any rate, we should just forget about[n]going after Akiyama-kun, okay?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm still worried about some of[n]the rumors I've heard about him,[n]but I'll do some more research.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: By the way, he's not as bad a guy[n]as he pretends to be. Apparently[n]he's super sweet to his girlfriend.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Can you imagine that? They've been[n]talking about getting married even[n]since back in middle school.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...I'm honestly kinda jealous.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Anyway, I'll see you later.
